principles.title: READ HIM, DON'T BLOCK HIM
principles.blurb: Leave the end unblocked and read him. He is wrong no matter what he does.

principles.title: SHOW THEM SOMETHING NEW
principles.blurb: Motion on everything. Nobody in this offense is ever just one thing.

principles.title: SPEED ALL OVER THE FIELD
principles.blurb: Get your fastest guys the ball in the most space you can find.

principles.title: SPREAD TO RUN
principles.blurb: Spread the field sideline to sideline, then run through the space it creates.

principles.title: MAKE DEFENSES WRONG
principles.blurb: Put a defender in a bind on every snap, wrong no matter what he does.

principles.title: STRESS THE FIELD
principles.blurb: Make the defense cover every blade of grass, then take the opening.

principles.title: MOTION EVERYTHING
principles.blurb: Something moves on almost every snap, so they never see the same picture twice.

principles.title: BALL IN OUR PLAYMAKERS' HANDS
principles.blurb: Elite athletes everywhere. The whole job is getting them the ball with room to work.

principles.title: EVERYTHING HAS A COUNTER
principles.blurb: Same motion, same look, a completely different answer already installed.

home.pitch: Five defensive backs to match the speed, still stout enough to stop the run. Match coverage as the base, and pressure that looks exactly like it.

principles.title: ADVANCED COVERAGE SHELLS
principles.blurb: Match coverage as the base, zone mixed off it, so the picture never repeats.

principles.title: DISGUISE EVERYTHING
principles.blurb: Blitzes and coverages look identical pre-snap. They never know what is coming.

principles.title: BUILT TO STOP THE SPREAD
principles.blurb: Five DBs to match the speed, still strong up front against the run.

home.pitch: The coverage rules under both defenses. Quarters against 2x2, Palms against trips, and the checks for bunch, empty and motion.

principles.title: MATCH IS AGGRESSIVE ZONE WITH RULES
principles.blurb: Not passive zone, not pure man. Zone defenders reading routes and reacting to whatever they get.

principles.title: MATCH KILLS THE META ROUTES
principles.blurb: Corners, crossers, deep posts. Quarters takes away every route people are living on right now.

principles.title: WHY SABAN BUILT HIS DEFENSE ON MATCH
principles.blurb: One defense with an answer for everything. Spread, empty, heavy. The rules adapt.

schemes.name: Alabama 3-4 Defense
schemes.subtitle: Crimson Tide · CFB 27
schemes.tagline: Control the line. Then bring everybody.

home.pitch: Three down and four backers on early downs, slide to Over Flex in the middle, bury them in the Mug on third and long.

book.note: every front and every call on the sheet lives inside it

principles.title: CONTROL THE LINE
principles.blurb: Three down, four backers. Win the line and the heavy sets die on first down.

principles.title: THE MIDDLE GROUND
principles.blurb: 335 Over Flex brings the extra DB and keeps the size. A nickel that still stops the run.

principles.title: OVERWHELM ON THIRD DOWN
principles.blurb: Load Dbl Mug on third and long. Two backers on the line, and the protection cannot count.
